strings: It's minor compared to the frostbite, but r_c remembers to bring along herbs for m_c's running nose when {PRONOUN/r_c/subject} {VERB/r_c/go/goes} to check up on {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.
As if frostbite wasn't a big enough worry, m_c has also developed a running nose.
m_c was out in the cold far too long. While the frostbite is the biggest concern, a running nose isn't a good sign either.
